nodes.title: SAM.gov Contracting — Official Federal Solicitations & Entity Registry
nodes.thresholds: Mandatory synopses > $25,000; Simplified Acquisitions $15,000–$350,000
nodes.summary: Primary federal portal for active Sources Sought, RFIs, Simplified Acquisition RFQs (<= $350K), and formal RFPs. Also houses the FAR 26.205 Disaster Response Registry.

nodes.title: SBA Small Business Search (SBS / Formerly DSBS)
nodes.thresholds: FAR 19.5 Rule-of-Two & VOSB/SDVOSB Market Research
nodes.summary: First directory Contracting Officers query to justify Small Business, VOSB, or SDVOSB set-asides and sole-source awards. Requires populated Capabilities Narrative and keywords.

nodes.title: Acquisition.gov — Agency Procurement Forecasts Directory
nodes.thresholds: Planned acquisitions > $350,000 SAT (6–18 months pre-RFP)
nodes.summary: Master federal index linking directly to every Cabinet and independent agency's annual Small Business Procurement Forecast prior to SAM.gov release.

nodes.title: GSA Acquisition Gateway — Cross-Agency Forecast Tool
nodes.thresholds: Upcoming Simplified & Major Acquisitions Nationwide
nodes.summary: Unified searchable database aggregating upcoming federal contracting opportunities across participating civilian agencies filterable by NAICS, state, and set-aside.

nodes.title: USA.gov A–Z Index of U.S. Government Departments and Agencies
nodes.thresholds: Agency mission & organizational routing
nodes.summary: Authoritative directory of every federal department, sub-agency, and independent commission for mapping buying offices and OSDBU entry points.

nodes.title: Executive Order 14434 (91 FR 63129) — Federal Super Intelligence (SI) Mandate
nodes.thresholds: Mandatory Executive Branch Correspondence, Portals, RFIs & Reports
nodes.summary: Directs federal agencies to use 'Super Intelligence' ('SI') in place of 'Artificial Intelligence' ('AI') across non-statutory communications while anchoring technical scope to 15 U.S.C. 9401(3) and preserving codified statutory citations.

nodes.title: FEMA Industry Liaison Program (ILP), NBEOC & Stafford Act (FAR 26.2)
nodes.jurisdiction: DHS / FEMA Region 9 (AZ, CA, NV, HI)
nodes.thresholds: Emergency GPC = $25,000 • Contingency SAT = $1,000,000 • Local-Area Set-Aside Preference
nodes.summary: Stafford Act (42 U.S.C. 5150) grants local-area set-aside priority to businesses inside declared counties alongside elevated $25K GPC and $1M SAT limits for accessible, multilingual digital response.

nodes.title: GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Roadmap & Vendor Support Center (VSC)
nodes.thresholds: $0 eOffer fee • Clause I-FSS-639 ($100K sales / 5-yr base) • Startup Springboard (IT SINs 54151S & 511210)
nodes.summary: Phase 2 IDIQ vehicle unlocking closed GSA eBuy RFQs. Section 9 of VSC houses mandatory free Pathways to Success and Readiness Assessment prerequisites; subcontractors under GSA primes do not need their own Schedule.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of Veterans Affairs (VA) OSDBU & Direct Access Program
nodes.thresholds: 38 U.S.C. 8127 Veterans First Rule of Two (Sole Source up to $5M)
nodes.summary: Enforces statutory SDVOSB (#1) and VOSB (#2) priority ahead of all other socioeconomic programs across VA medical centers (Phoenix, Tucson, Yuma, San Diego) and TAC/SAC.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of War / Defense (DoD) Office of Small Business Programs
nodes.platform: DoD OSBP & Installation Small Business Offices
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K ($25K Contingency) • PIEE Simplified <= $350K
nodes.summary: Directory of installation-level Small Business Professionals (SBPs) who sign DD Form 2579 small-business coordination records across Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force, and Defense Agencies.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of Labor (DOL) OSDBU
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K • SAT <= $350K
nodes.summary: Oversees small business contracting for DOL OASAM and Employment and Training Administration (author of TEN No. 07-25 AI Literacy Framework).

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of Education (ED) OSDBU
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K • SAT <= $350K
nodes.summary: Coordinates small-business IT, Section 508 / WCAG digital accessibility, educational R&D, and postsecondary technical assistance procurements.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of Agriculture (USDA) OSDBU
nodes.jurisdiction: Federal Cabinet (USDA / APHIS / NIFA / Rural Dev)
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K • SAT <= $350K
nodes.summary: Supports VOSB/small-business access across USDA agencies for Section 508 compliance, nutrition/food informatics, and rural agricultural technology.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of Health & Human Services (HHS) OSDBU
nodes.jurisdiction: Federal Cabinet (HHS / IHS / NIH / CDC / CMS)
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K • SAT <= $350K
nodes.summary: Gateway via HHS SBCX (SAM UEI login) to Indian Health Service (Phoenix/Tucson/Fort Yuma), NIH, CDC, HRSA, and CMS small-business specialists.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of the Interior (DOI) OSDBU
nodes.jurisdiction: Federal Cabinet (Reclamation / BIA / BIE / BLM / NPS)
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K • SAT <= $350K • Buy Indian Act
nodes.summary: Covers Bureau of Reclamation (Lower Colorado / Yuma Area Office), Bureau of Indian Education (BIE), BLM, and National Park Service procurements.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of the Treasury & IRS OSDBU
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K • SAT <= $350K
nodes.summary: Provides direct Small Business Specialist contacts for Treasury bureaus and IRS IT/workforce AI training task orders.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of Homeland Security (DHS) OSDBU
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K ($25K Emergency) • SAT <= $350K ($1M Emergency)
nodes.summary: Hosts monthly 15-minute virtual Vendor Outreach Sessions (VOS) connecting small businesses directly with CBP, CISA, FEMA, and DHS HQ buyers.

nodes.title: U.S. Dept. of Commerce, Justice, Energy, HUD, DOT & State OSDBUs
nodes.platform: Federal Small Business Offices Master Directory
nodes.thresholds: GPC <= $15K • SAT <= $350K
nodes.summary: Unified cross-agency OSDBU lookup spanning Commerce (NIST/MBDA/NOAA), Justice (ADA Title II), Energy (WAPA/National Labs), HUD, DOT (FAA), and State (FSI).

nodes.title: SBIR / STTR (America's Seed Fund) & Arizona Commerce Authority FAST Grant
nodes.jurisdiction: 11 Federal R&D Agencies + Arizona Commerce Authority
nodes.thresholds: Reauthorized via S. 3971 through Sept 30, 2031 • AZ FAST Phase 0 up to $3,000 • Unlimited Sole-Source Phase III
nodes.summary: 0%-equity federal R&D funding (20-yr SBIR Data Rights + sole-source Phase III authority). STTR brings >=30% R&D subawards into partner universities; AZ FAST prioritizes rural & Veteran Arizona tech firms.

nodes.title: SBA Directory of Federal Prime Contractors with Subcontracting Plans
nodes.thresholds: Mandatory on OTSB prime contracts > $750,000
nodes.summary: Official SBA dataset of 18,900+ large federal prime contracts required by law to maintain Small Business Subcontracting Plans and Small Business Liaison Officers (SBLOs).

nodes.title: FAR 52.219-14 (50% Cap) & FAR 52.215-23 (70% Pass-Through) + FCA Guardrails
nodes.platform: Acquisition.gov & DOJ False Claims Act (31 U.S.C. 3729)
nodes.thresholds: <= 50% to non-similarly situated firms on services set-asides; > 70% triggers Added-Value rule
nodes.summary: Prohibits set-aside fronts (>50% paid to non-SSEs on services) and disallowable >70% pass-through markups without documented technical/QA Added Value.

Zero-egress Sovereign Hybrid RAG (SQLite FTS5 BM25 + RRF), Air-Gapped Edge SI / AI (EO 14434), CMMC Level 1 / Zero-CUI

crosswalk.naicsTitle: R&D in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences
crosswalk.deliverables: SBIR/STTR Phase I–III R&D, Food Informatics, Clinical Simulation Telemetry, Desert AgTech ROI
EO 14434 Super Intelligence (SI) & U.S. DOL TEN No. 07-25 Workforce Literacy, $0 ZTC Dual-Namespace OER, Executive Briefings

crosswalk.deliverables: Independent Accessibility IV&V (ADA Title II 28 CFR Part 35), EO 14434 SI / 15 U.S.C. 9401(3) Governance & Risk Readiness
